style: Simple cartoon line drawing in black ink of {thing}. The man is a cheerful lanky shelter warden with a long nose, round glasses, a round steel helmet and a belted work jacket. Retro 1950s instruction manual illustration, bold clean outlines, no shading, no colour, plain pure white background, no text
note: Pip-Boy-like pictures for the sheet's hover texts (Marek 11-19). Our own mascot, not Vault Boy (Bethesda's).
